summary: GRAIL, Inc. filed an 8-K to report the appointment of Dr. Joshua Ofman as CEO, effective June 1, 2026, amending his offer letter. Terms include an $800,000 base salary, a 100% VCP target, and $2,000,000 in RSUs vesting over four years. The board approved the changes. No explicit departure of a prior CEO or board recommendation is noted. The filing cites customary triggers for severance upon a Change in Control. This is a routine executive succession and compensatory arrangement, not a forced departure. Watch for any subsequent proxy statement details on the transition.
